structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_MALFORMED_DATE: HL7/FHIR date field does not conform to required format (e.g. PID-7 birthdate not YYYYMMDD). Format-rigorous validators (e.g. official HL7 v2 parser) catch this; etlp-mapper mapping 26 (field-presence) does not.
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_MISSING_REQUIRED_SEGMENT: Required HL7 segment is absent (e.g. PV1 in ADT^A04).
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_INVALID_FIELD_FORMAT: HL7 coded field carries a value outside the allowed value set (e.g. PID-8 gender not in {M,F,O,U,A,N,U}). Value-set validators catch this; mapping 26 (field-presence) does not.
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD: Required HL7 field within a present segment is empty (e.g. PV1.2 patient-class blank, PV1.7 attending-doctor blank).
structural_codes.STRUCTURAL_TRIGGER_EVENT_MISMATCH: HL7 message header trigger event does not match the declared message type (e.g. ADT^A04 message header but EVN.1 != A04, or MSH.9 = ADT^A99).

structural_codes_note: Structural codes are emitted by deterministic validators (etlp-mapper Jute templates), not by the semantic council. They always route to BLOCK / reject and have no Tier-1 owner-map entry. They exist separately from KNOWN_TAXONOMY_CODES so the paper can measure structural-recall and semantic-recall independently.
